svg.text: TOM Big Picture — Demand Flow End-to-End
Demand opening & roles → Jira Request (Value Stream + fields) → Portfolio Board (ITBA · CS) → Team Boards

routed to ITBA or CS · triage · backlog · ready for execution

of problem, business value, acceptance criteria.

PORTFOLIO BOARDS — ROUTED BY VALUE STREAM
ITBA — IT Business Apps Portfolio Board
CS — Customer Services Apps Portfolio Board
TWO-GATE GOVERNANCE · Same model on both boards
Gate 1 — Shark Tank Committee · pre-investment pitch · Go / No-Go
Gate 2 — Portfolio Committee · investment approval & portfolio slotting
